definitions.ask: Should Obsidian ref notes and `bob ref show` get the same underline as the Mac Refs panel?
definitions.why: One visual language — a line you drew in Highlights reads as a line wherever Bob shows it

choices.label: Mac panel, Obsidian ref notes, and `bob ref show` all draw your underlines as underlines
The Mac panel and Obsidian change; `bob ref show` keeps plain ANSI bold
Only the Mac Refs panel changes; Obsidian and the terminal keep plain bold
